## Proposition
For fixed state S and remaining depth d, suppose a tested split has child W with C_(d-1)(W)=false. For any later admissible split (X,Y) restricted to S, W subset X OR W subset Y implies failure of the conjunction of child predicates, by R303 downward heredity. No inclusion condition on the other child is needed, unlike R309 two-child dominance. Maintain inclusion-minimal antichain of observed false children: when adding W discard W if an old F subset W, otherwise discard all old F supersets W. Every discarded witness's upward closure lies in the union of retained upward closures. Thus each prune is logically exact, including zeros, and induction over depth proves the optimized existential predicate equals the original. Saturated versus ordinary libraries are unchanged. Only completed false recursive calls are added; CUT propagates without recording an unknown as false. This is a Boolean decision observer of the frozen BRC carrier, not native arithmetic or tree realizability. No new physical equivalence or loss of original directed germ identity. The local antichain is temporary; evidence remains reproducible from the same frozen input and code. The independent author-side paired check is not independent scientific review.
